articles.title: SpaceX has an AI device prototype, and it sure sounds phone-ish
articles.summary: SpaceX reportedly showed investors a "handset-like" AI device before going public. It could be another signal SpaceX wants to expand into wireless.

articles.title: Ashton Kutcher leaving Sound Ventures to launch new VC firm with Morgan Beller
articles.summary: Sound built its reputation on concentrated, high-conviction bets in category-leading AI labs, while Kutcher's new fund appears to be chasing the layer underneath those companies — the infrastructure and energy that power them.

articles.title: Cloudflare’s new policy pushes AI companies to pay for publishers’ content
articles.summary: Cloudflare is giving AI companies until September 15 to separate web crawlers used for search from those used for AI training and agents, or risk being blocked by default on many publisher sites.

articles.title: Venice AI becomes a unicorn with $65M Series A as its privacy-first AI platform takes off
articles.summary: Venice AI is already profitable, with annualized run-rate revenues of over $70 million, CEO Erik Voorhees said.

articles.title: Gemini Spark, Google’s agentic assistant, is now available on Mac
articles.summary: Google's 24/7 agentic assistant, Gemini Spark, comes to Mac alongside other improvements, like real-time tracking and support for more apps.

articles.title: Builders Stage agenda revealed: Practical strategies for scaling startups at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
articles.summary: The Builders Stage is returning to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, bringing together 10,000+ founders, startup operators, and investors for practical conversations. and Q&A on what it takes to build and scale successful companies. Register now to save up to $330.

articles.title: Meta, like SpaceX, looks to turn excess AI compute into cash
articles.summary: Meta is developing plans for a cloud infrastructure business, selling access to AI compute power and models. The move would pit it against the big cloud providers like Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

articles.title: The ‘Father of the Internet’ is finally retiring
articles.summary: Vinton Cerf, one of the creators of the protocols underlying the internet, will step down as Google's chief internet evangelist next week.

articles.title: Trump drops restrictions on Anthropic’s Mythos and Fable models
articles.summary: The Trump administration's erratic approach to AI policymaking has left companies across the industry with little clarity about what will govern future model releases.

articles.title: Wayve launches $85M employee tender offer at $8.5B valuation
articles.summary: Wayve’s offering is part of a growing trend of AI startups using employee tenders as a strategic tool to attract and retain talent.

articles.title: OpenClaw is finally available on Android and iOS
articles.summary: The free open source agentic program is finally invading your phone.

articles.title: The DeepMind trio who built a poker AI are now making money for quant hedge funds
articles.summary: EquiLibre Technologies, a Prague-based AI lab founded by three ex-DeepMind researchers, is now valued at more than $500 million.

articles.title: Google introduces a faster, cheaper image generator with Nano Banana 2 Lite
articles.summary: Google is updating its image generator to make it faster and cheaper, making it a more useful tool for creators looking to make AI content.

articles.title: Nvidia competitor Etched hits $5B valuation, $1B in sales for AI chip
articles.summary: Nvidia AI chip competitor Etched says it has already booked $1 billion under contract for the inference systems powered by its chip.

articles.title: Anthropic launches Claude Sonnet 5 as a cheaper way to run agents
articles.summary: Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 5 brings stronger agentic capabilities, lower pricing, and improved safety, positioning the model as a cheaper alternative to Opus, GPT-5.5, and Gemini Pro.

articles.title: Acti puts AI agents directly into your smartphone keyboard
articles.summary: Acti is betting the smartphone keyboard is the next home for AI assistants. The startup's new keyboard for iOS and Android works across apps and lets users create custom AI-powered shortcuts using natural language.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Claude Science bets on workflow, not a new model, to win over scientists
articles.summary: Anthropic's Claude Science is a workbench that gives scientists one environment to do computational research, saving them from the need to bounce between databases, pipelines, and tools.

articles.title: X now offers an MCP server to make its platform easier for AI tools to use
articles.summary: X has launched a hosted MCP server, making it easier for developers to connect AI applications with the company’s API.

articles.title: Podcasting platform Riverside enters the newsletter publishing game
articles.summary: Users will be able use AI to create newsletters based on their recordings.

articles.title: Amazon launches new $1 billion FDE org, following OpenAI and Anthropic
articles.summary: Engineers on the new team will embed within companies to deploy purpose-built agents, focusing on fast deployments and customer self-sufficiency.

articles.title: Cloud Capital and Realty Income partner for $6bn data center joint venture fund
articles.summary: JV acquires stakes in three Virginia data centers

articles.title: It’s a sprint and a marathon: why capital continues to define data center leaders
articles.summary: The real winners will be those who have the stamina to sustain their pace

articles.title: 150MW data center planned for North Frisia, Germany, attracts protests
articles.summary: Residents skeptical about height of the proposed development

articles.title: AWS launches Secret Cloud for Industry
articles.summary: Gives US defense contractors secure access to cloud

articles.title: Egypt greenlights license for $400m data center expansion
articles.summary: The initiative backs the country’s strategy for data centers and cloud computing

articles.title: South Korea announces $919bn investment into three “mega projects,” plans to build 18.4GW worth of data centers by 2035
articles.summary: Ambitious plan aims to put the country at the forefront of the AI race

articles.title: Tata Communications announces India-Singapore subsea cable investments
articles.summary: Connecting Mumbai-Singapore and Chennai-Singapore

articles.title: Sponsored: Data center sustainability starts with electrical infrastructure
articles.summary: As hyperscale growth continues and sustainability expectations intensify, sustainable electrification will increasingly depend on how intentionally the industry approaches electrical infrastructure decisions

articles.title: Supermicro's Taiwan office raided in ongoing Nvidia smuggling probe, more employees detained by prosecutors – report
articles.summary: Follows announcement last month that company was working with authorities to stop illegal shipments of AI servers

articles.title: Gigawatt-scale behind-the-meter data center campus proposed in Australia's Northern Territories
articles.summary: Site would include 3GW of solar, 16GWh of battery storage, and 1.1GW of natural gas generation

articles.title: Firmus signs 600MW energy supply agreement in South Australia
articles.summary: Will support next phase of Project Southgate

articles.title: Inference chip startup Etched emerges from stealth with $800m funding, unveils working chip
articles.summary: Chip was produced on TSMC’s N4P process technology

articles.title: Omen AI raises $31m to develop fluid monitoring system for data centers
articles.summary: Good omens for the lifespan of data center equipment

articles.title: AWS and Anduril partner on Edge cloud offering for national security and defense
articles.summary: Anduril introduces Menace-I with AWS Outposts

articles.title: DCD Studio: Retelit's data center strategy with Laura Castagna, Retelit
articles.summary: Georgia Butler speaks with Laura Castagna of Retelit about Italy's rapidly growing data center market, AI-driven demand, sustainable infrastructure and the opportunities shaping the country's digital future.

articles.title: Schneider Electric to acquire industrial AI business Cognite for $3.1bn
articles.summary: Folding into Aveva

articles.title: Boeing outage significantly disrupts commercial and military production across US
articles.summary: Not believed to be a cyberattack

articles.title: DigitalBridge and JEXI launch new data center colo provider in Japan
articles.summary: Nippon Gateway Infrastructure seeded with assets acquired from NEC

articles.title: DCD Studio: Cloud adoption and the AI boom in Italy with Tiziano Durante, Microsoft
articles.summary: Georgia Butler speaks with Tiziano Durante of Microsoft on Italy's booming data center market, Microsoft’s €4.3bn investment, AI-driven cloud growth, digital sovereignty, and the role of hybrid cloud in innovation.

articles.title: Sponsored: Rehlko releases 2026 Powering Impact Report, highlighting sustainable power progress for data centers
articles.summary: In 2025, Rehlko deployed flexible, lower-emission energy solutions, supporting ~20 percent emissions reduction in own operations

articles.title: Eversource launches targeted load management pilots in Massachusetts
articles.summary: The programs address specific substations with high solar penetration or summer-peak congestion issues. They could expand in the coming years, a spokesperson said.

articles.title: EPA’s tougher soot standard upheld in court
articles.summary: The D.C. Circuit rejected a challenge from states and industry groups, leaving the National Ambient Air Quality Standards for fine particulate matter, including from power plants, in place as litigation over implementation continues.

articles.title: Can zinc-based batteries scale into US storage buildout?
articles.summary: Support from the U.S. Department of Energy will be critical to the industry’s near-term success as customers look to lithium alternatives, International Zinc Association officials told Utility Dive.

articles.title: California delays emissions reporting deadline by 3 months
articles.summary: The California Air Resources Board said it will delay the compliance deadline for California’s SB 253 — the Climate Corporate Data Accountability Act — and propose “limited changes.”

articles.title: Duke gives up offshore wind lease for ‘partial’ reimbursement under Interior deal
articles.summary: A Duke Energy subsidiary paid $155 million for the lease in 2022, saying it could support up to 1.6 GW of capacity. The utility now says it will “refocus” nearly $129 million to projects that may include new nuclear, natural gas and grid enhancements.

articles.title: From wildfire risk to resilience: How asset investment tools can mitigate the growing challenge
articles.summary: A shift in asset investment planning can help utilities quantify risk and defend wildfire mitigation plans to regulators, stakeholders and the public, writes Jeff Pauska at IFS Copperleaf.

articles.title: Sen. King urges FERC to reject $67B NextEra-Dominion merger
articles.summary: NextEra Energy’s efforts to kill the New England Clean Energy Connect transmission project is a sign of how the combined utility could stifle competition and harm consumers, the Maine senator said.

articles.title: Virginia defines agrivoltaics, expanding opportunities for solar
articles.summary: Agrivoltaic projects must “ensure flexibility for farmers to adapt to market conditions and support operational needs,” according to the law.

articles.title: PJM opposes waiver for $2B gas-fired plant in fast-track interconnection review
articles.summary: Gas turbine backlogs prompted Advanced Power Services to seek changes to its project in PJM’s fast-track Reliability Resource Initiative interconnection review, but the grid operator said granting such a waiver would be unfair to other developers.

articles.title: Utilities are not spending enough on low-income household efficiency: ACEEE
articles.summary: Energy efficiency becomes more important as prices rise because it is “one of the only direct levers” a household has to reduce its bills, said Anna Johnson, senior policy manager at the American Council for an Energy-Efficient Economy.

articles.title: Smolensk II's new concrete mixing unit commissioned
articles.summary: The commissioning of the first new facility relating to the construction of the second phase of the Smolensk Nuclear Power Plant comes ahead of work beginning on excavating the foundation pit for the first new unit.

articles.title: What changes are needed to help rollout of advanced nuclear technologies in UK?
articles.summary: There are currently several barriers to enabling the widespread deployment of advanced nuclear technologies in the UK, delegates heard at the NextGen Nuclear Summit held in London.

articles.title: UK fusion sector poised for industrial scale-up
articles.summary: The UK fusion energy sector is entering a decisive transition from laboratory development to industrial-scale delivery, driven by rising private investment, sustained government backing, and an evolving regulatory framework designed to support deployment, speakers said at the NextGen Nuclear Summit, held in London.

articles.title: Fusion plant clears regulatory milestone
articles.summary: The receipt of two licences from the Washington Department of Health marks a major milestone for fusion company Helion in its project to build its Orion nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Sites selected for Korean nuclear new build
articles.summary: Yeongdeok in North Gyeongsang Province has been selected by Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power for two new large-scale nuclear reactors. Gijang, in Busan, has been chosen to site a new small modular reactor.

articles.title: Estonia's Parliament passes new nuclear energy law
articles.summary: The Nuclear Energy and Safety Act sets out key steps required for the deployment of nuclear energy in Estonia, including rules "for selecting the location of a nuclear power plant and for its construction, testing, and operation, as well as the rules for its decommissioning, and the final disposal of nuclear waste".

articles.title: Heavy water delivered for Argentina's RA-10 multipurpose reactor
articles.summary: Twenty drums, containing six tonnes of heavy water, have been transferred from the Heavy Water Industrial Plant in Neuquén to the Ezeiza Atomic Centre for use in the neutron reflector system for Argentina's new RA-10 multipurpose reactor.

articles.title: Shine, Newcleo join up to close nuclear fuel cycle
articles.summary: US fusion energy company Shine has joined a consortium that is working to build US nuclear fuel recycling capability. It has also agreed to work with France-based company Newcleo to link Shine's recycling capabilities with Newcleo's reactors, which are designed to run on recycled fuel.

articles.title: World's oldest operating nuclear units back on India's grid
articles.summary: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited says that following extensive modernisation and refurbishment the first two units at India's oldest nuclear power plant, Tarapur Atomic Power Station, are now back delivering power.

articles.title: Concrete poured for reactor shaft at Leningrad's eighth unit
articles.summary: The pouring of concrete has begun for the reactor shaft at what will be the eighth unit at the Leningrad nuclear power plant. The reinforced concrete structure will ultimately stand 34 metres tall.

articles.title: Centrus, Oklo HALEU agreement to support reactor deployment
articles.summary: US enrichment company Centrus is to supply Oklo with high-assay low-enriched uranium to power up to five Aurora powerhouses for multiple years, with deliveries scheduled to begin in 2029.

articles.title: Elementl Power plans BWRX-300 SMRs in Ohio
articles.summary: Nuclear power plant developer Elementl Power has signed an Early Works Agreement with GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy to use its BWRX-300 small modular reactors for a proposed project in Meigs County, in southeast Ohio in the USA.

articles.title: Valar Atomics achieves criticality in DOE Reactor Pilot Program
articles.summary: Valar Atomics' Ward 250 advanced reactor has completed a zero-power fuelled criticality demonstration, becoming the second to meet the 4 July deadline for the US Department of Energy’s Reactor Pilot Program.

articles.title: IAEA produces global mapping tool of used nuclear fuel
articles.summary: The global total of used nuclear fuel produced by nuclear power plants is about 448,000 tonnes of heavy metal, with three quarters in storage and one quarter reprocessed, according to the International Atomic Energy Agency's first interactive tool showing how much used nuclear fuel the world has - and where it is stored - by country.

articles.title: Agreement secures management of Canadian low-level legacy waste
articles.summary: A new long-term agreement between Atomic Energy of Canada Limited and the Municipality of Port Hope extends Canada's responsibility to safely manage eligible historic low-level radioactive waste in Port Hope for up to 100 years after the Port Hope Long-Term Waste Management Facility closes.

articles.title: Flushing work under way for Changjiang unit 4
articles.summary: Nuclear loop flushing work has begun at the Changjiang nuclear power plant's fourth unit in China's Hainan province, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Canada aims to grow nuclear and uranium capacity, at home and abroad
articles.summary: The first-ever national nuclear strategy released by the Canadian government outlines a vision of new nuclear builds, as well as expanded uranium production, and a strengthened supply chain, as the nation works towards its ambition to become an "energy superpower".

articles.title: Fusion supply chain spend up, but challenges remain
articles.summary: The Fusion Industry Association has reported that supply chain spending by the fusion industry rose 25% to USD538 million in 2025, but ensuring access to specialist materials and fuel systems remains a continuing concern.

articles.title: Major component milestone for Indian reactor
articles.summary: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Ltd says the successful unloading of the first End Shield is a major milestone for the Kaiga 5 and 6 construction project.

articles.title: Cold hydraulic tests under way at Turkey's Akkuyu 1
articles.summary: Construction of Turkey's first new nuclear power unit has been completed and cold-hot testing - a key part of the commissioning process - has begun, Rosatom has said.
